The current draft outlines the commercial opportunity and projected fee income, but it's missing several critical risk parameters — no final exposure cap, no reserve amount, no monitoring schedule, no termination right, and no credit-support requirement. As it stands, I cannot approve this. I'd like to hear from each of you — model risk, compliance, legal, and relationship management — on your findings so we can determine what terms need to be built into the approval. Let's start with your assessments.
